correctness.rationale: For the stated proper iid positive integer L with finite mean, age law P(A_t=a)=u(t-a)P(L>a), renewal epoch function u(s)<=1. With d=gcd support and K=L/d span1, arithmetic renewal theorem yields u(dn)->1/nu, nu=EK. Along t=dn+j only ages dk+j appear, with tails P(L>dk+j)=P(K>k), summable since sum P(K>k)=nu. Dominated convergence establishes total variation convergence of full age law and trace-norm convergence of rho_t to U^jBU^-j. For |z|=1, H_K(z)=(1-E z^K)/(nu(1-z)) cannot vanish for z!=1 because equality Ez^K=1 forces z^K=1 a.s., then gcd=1 implies z=1. Each active offdiagonal of rho* persists in B; Hilbert–Schmidt phase gap equals sum of nonnegative terms and vanishes iff [U,rho*]=0 for d>1. For d=1 convergence is automatic regardless of commutator. Exact qubit witness L=2 or4, U=diag(1,i) has gap sqrt2/3. Independently checked convolution/predicted age limits, spectral multiplier and witness in finite examples; the infinite law invokes renewal theorem, not finite tests.
